Compare direct prompting against structured hypothesis-generation + exact verification
tasks.success_test: Matched ablation tests structured generate-test-reject search against frozen direct prompting.
tasks.progress: REJECT: treatment 1/8 (12.5%) vs frozen comparator 4/8 (50%), zero new solves, three regressions, two parse failures, 41,344 tokens. Strict natural-language hypothesis + full training-grid replay is not promoted.

tasks.title: Test compact multi-hypothesis generation with discriminative verification
tasks.success_test: A frozen matched ablation tests whether multiple compact candidate rules plus low-token discriminative verification can recover new solves without the full-grid replay serialization/regression failure seen in ARC-R017.
tasks.progress: REJECT after provider recovery: final treatment 2/8 (25%) versus comparator 4/8 (50%), one new solve, three regressions, two candidate parse failures, zero unresolved provider failures, 15 calls, 56,726 tokens and 380.112 seconds summed runtime.

tasks.title: Audit compact-hypothesis candidate coverage versus selector mistakes
tasks.success_test: Classify ARC-R018 parseable failures by whether a correct candidate existed but was not selected versus whether the generated candidate set lacked a correct answer, quantify the failure modes from durable evidence, and recommend one falsifiable successor experiment.
tasks.progress: ARC-R018 found one new solve but three regressions. Two recovered comparator-solved tasks parsed successfully and still failed, while a third regression hit the candidate output cap. Diagnose coverage versus selection before another architecture treatment.
